propositions: An LLM-Review -1 vote has two meanings: real findings (require code amendment) and infrastructure vetoes (coverage-gap family, which the contributor cannot fix, requiring manual re-run or new patchset)
Contributors need a self-service retrigger mechanism (like CI's recheck) that re-runs the review for infrastructure failures but refuses to retry real findings to prevent dice-rolled self-approval

A Gerrit comment containing the token 'recheck-review' must trigger eligibility checking against the bot's current-revision message tag from authoritative Gerrit state, refusing only BLOCK — finding (bare or merge-change form) and allowing all other states

The retrigger path must reset the per-revision attempts budget (harmonized with ticket 0347's bounded retry ledger) and enqueue a forced re-review via the existing _rebar_force machinery, bypassing dedup and existing-vote checks
The Gerrit comment-reply path must post messages with no labels key in the REST body, never writing a vote directly, to preserve the fail-closed invariant
Webhooks configuration must add comment-added event subscription and the service-user.sh script must be re-run by an operator before the trigger becomes active
